CSCA score report (China Scholastic Competency Assessment) for undergraduate applicants.
For the undergraduate preparatory programme: a pre-admission letter from the admitting institution.
Signed Beijing Government Scholarship application form from your host university. If you do not meet the academic score rule, you may add other proof of your academic or research ability.
